description: The BIG-IP ASM and F5 Advanced Web Application Firewall (Advanced WAF) attack signature check may fail to detect and block certain HTTP requests.
impact:
The attack signature check fails to detect and block such requests, as expected of a security policy.

Symptoms

As a result of this issue, some requests are not blocked by Advanced WAF or the BIG-IP ASM system.
recommended_actions:
You can enable the Several Content-Length headers violation for existing security policies by performing the following procedure:

Impact of action: Performing the following procedure should not have a negative impact on your system.

Log in to the Configuration utility of your affected Advanced WAF and BIG-IP ASM system.
Go to Security > Application Security > Policy Building > Learning and Blocking Settings.
From the Current edited policy list, select the security policy you want.
In the search field under the Policy Building Settings section, type the following:

Several Content-Length headers

Alternatively, you can locate the Several Content-Length headers violation under the HTTP protocol compliance failed sub-section of the Policy Building Settings section.

Select Enable for the violation.
To save the change, select Save.
To effect the change to the currently selected security policy, select Apply Policy.
To confirm, select OK.
status_text:
F5 Product Development has assigned ID 1051209 to this issue. This issue has been classified as CWE-693: Protection Mechanism Failure.

To determine if your product and version have been evaluated for this issue, refer to the Applies to (see versions) box.
